coaching_note: Address the customer's specific worry in the moment — Thorn raised concerns about moving the treadmill and never got a direct answer, and pair that with running the Save Your Ass prep speech (consolidation tips, take-a-carload tip) before booking, since that section and the No Worries/Meet Your Mover/On-Time Guarantee differentiators were skipped entirely on this call.
phone_presence_notes: Zachary was polite and responsive with a couple of natural affirmations ('For sure,' 'Absolutely, we're open seven days a week'), but the call stayed transactional throughout with no name use, no humor, and no acknowledgment of the customer's treadmill concern.
